programme.desc: Karamjit 'The Flying Sikh' Singh berkongsi erti sebenar berbakti kepada negara, sempena ulang tahun ke-30 Astro ini buat para atlet dan veteran yang telah mencurahkan bakti kepada Malaysia.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Tiga
programme.desc: Kisah seorang puteri kayangan yang berkahwin dengan seorang raja tetapi telah disumpah apabila rahsianya sebagai seorang puteri kayangan terbongkar.

programme.title: 7 Minggu Sebelum Kahwin
programme.desc: Hanya tinggal 7 minggu saja tarikh perkahwinan, pelbagai masalah menimpa Amar dan Syifa yang mengganggu persiapan dan menduga cinta mereka.

programme.title: Main Kahwin Kahwin
programme.desc: Impian perkahwinan Nina musnah kerana kecurangan tunangnya. Sahabatnya Azam mencadangkan Nina untuk merancang perkahwinannya seperti 'main kahwin kahwin' ketika zaman kanak-kanak mereka.

programme.title: Cinta Sambal Belacan
programme.desc: Angah sering kalah kepada Aini di dalam satu pertandingan memasak. Angah cuba mencari bahan rahsia yang sering digunakan oleh Aini di dalam masakannya & cuba mengalahkan Aini namun tanpa sedar dia mula men

programme.title: KUDRAT 1968: High Council
programme.desc: Selepas pertuduhan Abbas terhadapnya, legasi Kuda makin rapuh, dan Kuda kini tercabar untuk mengekalkan pengaruhnya di KUDRAT.

programme.title: Cinta Kura-Kura
programme.desc: Seekor kura-kura yang boleh bercakap cuba membantu seorang gadis untuk mendapatkan calon kekasih yang sesuai buatnya. Lakonan Tizz Zaqyah & Zizan Razak.

programme.title: Lesen Besar
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan yang rindu zaman bujang mereka telah merancang untuk pergi 'road trip' setelah mendapat pelepasan daripada isteri dan teman wanita masing-masing. Tapi nasib tidak menyebelahi mereka di sepanja

programme.title: Aku Tunggu Kau Ni
programme.desc: Bagaikan terkena petir, Imran mendapati bakal kakak iparnya adalah junior yang pernah dihina, dibuli dan ditolak cintanya semasa di kolej dulu. Kerana Imranlah Fina gagal bab cinta dan menghadapi sindrom m

programme.title: Love, Nora
programme.desc: Raoul yang kematian isteri, sering mendapat emel dari isterinya untuk terus tabah meneruskan hidup dan membina hidup baru. Lakonan Yasmin Hani, Will Quah & Yana Shamsuddin.

programme.title: New York Cinta
programme.desc: Mia melanjutkan pelajaran ke Amerika Syarikat untuk mendalami bidang muzik namun ditakdirkan dia bertemu dengan Seth lalu jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Cinta Kolestrol
programme.desc: Kisah cinta Fazira dan Ahmad Yusry yang dijodohkan sedari kecil namun bila dewasa saiz badan pula menjadi ukuran dan cinta hanyalah bahan gurauan. Dibintangi oleh Erra Fazira dan Yusry Abdul Halim,

programme.title: Mael Lambong
programme.desc: Mael Lambong merupakan seorang penarik kereta terkenal di KL. Kehidupannya mula menjadi huru-hara setelah berjumpa dengan Maria yang meminta bantuannya untuk mengelak dari penjahat yang mengejarnya.

programme.title: Sayang Salmah
programme.desc: Salleh, seorang pemuda yang gemar berfoya-foya mengahwini Salmah, perempuan joget. Salleh mempunyai abang yang menghidap 'schizophrenia' yang mula diabaikan selepas Salleh dan isteri berpindah.

programme.title: TERBANG The Making Of
programme.desc: Haunted by tragedy, Ajeet returns to rally races with Kitt and Imran. Can Malaysia's underdog PERT team top the world's best? Inspired by the extraordinary journey of Malaysian rally legend Karamjit Singh.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Tujoh
programme.desc: Kisah kesetiaan dan ketaatan Tengku Mahkota Mahreen dalam usahanya mencari tujuh orang puteri. Lakonan Noordin Ahmad, Latifah Omar.

programme.title: Amir & Loqman Pergi Ke Laut
programme.desc: Terdesak untuk keluar dari kumpulan kongsi gelap yang pada suatu ketika dulu mereka pernah kagumi, dua penjenayah mendapati mereka harus berdepan dengan satu ancaman yang lebih bahaya.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Kahwin Kahwin
programme.desc: 3 kisah di dalam 1 telemovie iaitu 1. Sedang Suka Kamu 2. Rindu Yang Kembali 3. Assalamualaikum Ustazah

programme.title: Karya 12 - Roti Canai Love Story
programme.desc: Kisah hubungan persahabatan di antara kanak-kanak berbangsa Melayu dan Cina yang bermula dari kisah sekeping roti canai dan konflik keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Jejaka Perasan
programme.desc: Filem komedi era 80an tentang dua orang jejaka yang berhijrah ke kota untuk memperbaiki hidup. Lakonan Salih Yaacob, AR Badul, Hamid Gurkha dan Liza Abdullah.

programme.title: Merewang Keluarga Pak Awang
programme.desc: Merewang Keluarga Pak Awang menceritakan tentang Pak Awang iaitu seorang bekas komander yang merancang sendirian kenduri perkahwinan anak bongsunya.

programme.title: Kereta Sorong nenek
programme.desc: Kisah tentang seorang nenek yang menjaja makanan di tepi laut sambil menyorong kereta kayu.

programme.title: 3 Temujanji
programme.desc: Reanna tidak mempercayai lelaki dan cinta. Reanna menetapkan setiap hubungannya dengan lelaki tidak akan lebih dari tiga temujanji sahaja. Namun, perasaannya mula berubah setelah bertemu Mikhail.

programme.title: My Spy
programme.desc: Ikuti gandingan lucu AJ dan Salleh dalam aksi mereka dalam menyelesaikan kes penyeledupan lukisan yang amat berharga. Lakonan AC Mizal & Harun Salim Bachik.

programme.title: Oh Mak Kau
programme.desc: Sam dan Mun adalah dua perompak. Ketika wanita kegemaran mereka kembali ke kampung dari bandar, keduanya menghadapi pengalaman yang mengubah hidup di tengah persaingan untuk memikat hati sang wanita.

SLOT 2.30 PETANG: JALAN TERUS SAMPAI JADI (SELASA), EKSKLUSIF (ISNIN-JUMAAT).DENGARKAN SLOT SUARA 34 PUNCAK PRESTASI (SABTU-AHAD) PADA 3.20 PETANG-3.54 PETANG, MANAKALA PROGRAM SILANG BUDAYA (SABTU-AHAD) PADA 3 PETANG - 4 PETANG, MENERUSI FB DAN TIK TOK LIVE NASIONALfm.

programme.title: NASIONAL WARNA GKP
programme.desc: SANTAI PETANG DENGAN PENYAMPAI GENG KAKAK PETANG ZURA DAN LYNN (ISNIN-JUMAAT) . PENGISIAN LAGU-LAGU POPULAR RETRO DENGAN SEGMEN LUAHAN KAKAK ABANG, RESEPI MANJA-MANJA JE DAN DRAMA DALAM KERETA (RABU & KHAMIS). SEGMAN BIS ON AIR JUGA AKAN BERSIARAN PADA 6.00 PETANG SERTA INFO DAN TOPIK SEMASA YANG MENARIK SEMASA PEMANDUAN. JUGA BERSIARAN MENERUSI LIVE TIK TOK NASIONALfm. DENGARKAN PENGISIAN PROGRAM AGAMA RAUDHAH.

programme.title: NASIONAL MALAM.
programme.desc: SANTAI MALAM BERSAMA PENYAMPAI AJ, REDZA DAN AIZAT DENGAN LAGU-LAGU HITS DAN POPULAR. SEGMEN PILIHAN BERSAMA MENANTI PENDENGAR MENERUSI FB DAN TIK TOK LIVE NASIONALfm. SLOT KAUNTER ARTIS BERSAMA ARTIS DAN SELEBRITI POPULAR SETIAP HARI RABU 9.15 MALAM - 10 MALAM.\n

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.desc: Assalamualaikum...Mulakan hari anda dengan SALAMfm-Salam Untuk Semua. Kami temani malam anda dengan segmen Salam Santai bermula pukul 12.00 tengah malam hingga 4 pagi dengan pelbagai pengisian program Islamik menarik dan hiburan yang mendidik jiwa.

programme.title: INTERAKSI 2026
programme.desc: Jom sertai program santai yang memberi peluang pendengar untuk berinteraksi bersama DJ menerusi topik-topik Islamik yang berbeza setiap minggu.

programme.desc: Drama berunsur Islamik yang menampilkan Ustaz Aqil dibintangi Ustaz PU Rahmat sebagai watak utama dan dj-dj SALAMfm sebagai pelakon tambahan tentunya akan menarik halwa telinga anda. Nantikan istimewa hanya di SALAMfm.

programme.title: TAMADUN ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Kami kongsikan kepada anda perincian mengenai kisah Sirah dan tokoh-tokoh Islam terkemuka serta tidak ketinggalan kisah keagungan peradaban Islam.

programme.title: Nota Silam

programme.title: Abang Tinted & Handbag Ajaib

Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Boo! Did that scare you? If so, then you better steer clear of this super spooky Holiday Eatz Halloween episode with chef-host Kimberly Lallouz! But that would be too bad, because then you'd miss a menu featuring fun but grown-up Halloween eats like Jack O'Lantern Curry, served with Irish-inspired spiced Pumpkin Barmbrack bread. Next, you'd miss a ghostly surprise with her pan seared Black Cod buried in a pile of carrot-chip 'Autumn Leaves' and drizzled with mango sauce made with"... ghost peppers! Her 'Fet Ghede' (Haitian Day of the Dead) inspired beef rib follows"... with a rib bone connected to"... melting tender beef braised in Haiti's signature Epis spice and crunched-up with yummy pumpkin seeds. For a sweet ending, it's a 'Bag of Candy'"... or in this case, homemade profiterole stuffed with mascarpone and all of your favourite candies! See, that wasn't so scary, was it? Mwahahahaha!

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Popular Athens Recipes
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Greek Night
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: Canada + Greece
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: Hearty Greek Fare
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: Leaves and Lettuces
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E023
programme.desc: Clementina acusa sorpresa cuando Victoria le da a entender que va a darle a Builder la oportunidad de conquistarla; sin embargo, la joven Guanipa sigue añorando sus momentos de amor con Nicolás. Antonieta se aparta de Felipe pidiéndole que entienda que no debe volverla a besar porque ella es una mujer comprometida; el joven quiere hacerle entender que Jonás no la merece e intenta besarla de nuevo. A Caravaggio le parece que uno de los atractivos de Victoria es que no se deja impresionar por cualquiera, prueba de ello es que mandó a investigar a Jack; la joven se interesa en saber qué logró averiguar el periodista sobre el actor. Adelaida se conmueve al leer la nueva carta que le entrega Hilario, quien indaga qué más tiene que hacer para convencerla de lo que siente por ella.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E024
programme.desc: Nicolás se pone celoso cuando Jonás le comenta que Jack invitó a Victoria a jugar pool y que está seguro de que esa noche su amigo va a lograr besarla. Builder no se amilana ante las exigencias de Nicolás de que deje tranquila a Victoria y comienzan a discutir al punto que se caen a golpes hasta que la joven Guanipa y un mesonero los separan; Victoria le reclama a Del Casal su actitud posesiva con ella; él la besa con pasión para demostrarle qué le da derecho a sentirse así. Eugenia llama a Yosmir para darle las gracias por la torta que le llevó cuando fue a visitarla; él aparte de reprocharle la forma en que lo trató frente a Fernanda, le dice lo que piensa de toda su familia logrando molestarla. Fernanda recibe una nota anónima donde le advierten que la estafa a Cantarrana no se va a quedar así y ella pagará por eso. Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que está corriendo peligro, pero le asegura que él la va a proteger.

programme.desc: Carlos Alfredo está completamente deshecho por la salud de su hija y se refugia en el alcohol. Carlos Alfredo va a casa de Carlota y le pregunta cuál es su relación de Cheíto y Abigaíl y ella le dice que son amantes.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E011 - Episode 11
programme.desc: Ninoska no entiende por qué Carlos Alfredo defiende a Cheíto ante la policía. Álvaro le confiesa su amor a Abigail. Mariana le exige a Abigail decirle la verdad sobre su enfermedad. María Begoña vestida de María Clara, pide a Carlota irse de la ciudad.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E20
programme.desc: Gertrudis le confiesa a su esposo que Alberto no es su hijo. Marco Aurelio confiesa a Lorena que ella tenía razón, su hermano y su esposa son amantes. programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E20

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E74
programme.desc: Clara Inés es atendida por el doctor Galeano, quien diagnostica que necesita tranquilidad para no caer en depresión.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E75
programme.desc: Nicolás entrega a Clara Inés identificación donde valido que las huellas dactilares en la máscara pertenecen a una mujer, Clara Inés constata que se trata de Pastora.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E024
programme.desc: Nicolás se pone celoso cuando Jonás le comenta que Jack invitó a Victoria a jugar pool y que está seguro de que esa noche su amigo va a lograr besarla. Builder no se amilana ante las exigencias de Nicolás de que deje tranquila a Victoria y comienzan a discutir al punto que se caen a golpes hasta que la joven Guanipa y un mesonero los separan; Victoria le reclama a Del Casal su actitud posesiva con ella; él la besa con pasión para demostrarle qué le da derecho a sentirse así. Eugenia llama a Yosmir para darle las gracias por la torta que le llevó cuando fue a visitarla; él aparte de reprocharle la forma en que lo trató frente a Fernanda, le dice lo que piensa de toda su familia logrando molestarla. Fernanda recibe una nota anónima donde le advierten que la estafa a Cantarrana no se va a quedar así y ella pagará por eso. Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que está corriendo peligro, pero le asegura que él la va a proteger.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E025
programme.desc: Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que, contrario a lo que ella piensa, Florencia pudiera estar siendo utilizada por Hilario en su contra. Victoria se conmueve al ver a Nicolás bajo la lluvia esperando que ella le dé una respuesta; Clementina insta a su amiga a no ceder todavía. Eugenia se molesta al leer la nota que le envió Yosmir con el libro que le regaló sugiriéndole que, cuando vuelva a ir a la cancha de bateo, lleve a su mamá con ella. Nicolás le deja un mensaje en el celular a Fernanda pidiéndole que no salga de su casa, pues no saben qué quiere la persona que la está amenazando y él no se perdonaría que le pase algo por no haberla detenido a tiempo en su plan.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E02
programme.desc: Carlos revela ante Adriana la comprometida visión que tiene de ser padre; la chef vuelve a molestarse con el médico en el instante que una mujer se acerca a él seductora.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E21
programme.desc: Alberto y Malena van a visitar a su padre, y ambos hermanos se encuentran a Marco Aurelio muerto en su cama, con un tiro en el corazón. Gertrudis, en excelente teatro, cae "desmayada". Lorena está en el hospital con su pequeño. Alberto descarta por completo la posibilidad de que Lorena sea la responsable del asesinato de su padre. Gertrudis siente que le estalla el corazón, al ver que Claudio es detenido por la policía.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E22
programme.desc: Gertrudis, sin piedad, echa a Malena de la casa Corona; ella suplicante se niega a regresar con Pablo. Gertrudis y Claudio celebran su triunfo, cuando llaman a la puerta y vemos que se trata de Alberto.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E025
programme.desc: Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que, contrario a lo que ella piensa, Florencia pudiera estar siendo utilizada por Hilario en su contra. Victoria se conmueve al ver a Nicolás bajo la lluvia esperando que ella le dé una respuesta; Clementina insta a su amiga a no ceder todavía. programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E026
programme.desc: Victoria y Nicolás se besan enamorados; él le promete que siempre estará a su lado antes de sumergirse con ella en el mar en medio de un apasionado beso. Antonieta y Eugenia exigen a Leopoldo les diga qué está ocurriendo con Fernanda que no ha aparecido desde temprano. Hilario disfruta la velada con Florencia en un parque de diversiones donde la joven lo abraza y asegura saber que él la va a proteger siempre; mientas que, internamente, contiene la rabia que siente por el hombre. Hansen siente cierta decepción cuando Adelaida sugiere que lo quiere como un hermano y confía en que él no sería capaz de ocultarle algo que le hiciera daño. Carlos está a punto de confesarle su amor a la mujer, pero desiste cuando ella le habla de que su único sueño es que su amor por Hilario convierta su matrimonio en algo distinto a lo que es actualmente.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E027
programme.desc: Hilario de forma astuta maneja la situación frente a Leopoldo y los policías que lo acompañan, de tal manera que Monteverde queda como único indiciado en el secuestro de Fernanda. Victoria asegura que va a demostrarle a Nicolás que está equivocado sobre Hilario, pero él le indica que no es así, pues a Guanipa lo encontraron en el lugar donde tenía secuestrada a Fernanda aunque él supo librarse de lo ocurrido; la pareja acuerda defender su amor y tratar de superar lo que los separa. Hilario se presenta en casa de Carmencita a conversar con Victoria pero, en vista de que no está, decide aprovechar la oportunidad para explicarle a Adelaida que él la ama a pesar de tener otras mujeres.

Hilario disfruta la velada con Florencia en un parque de diversiones donde la joven lo abraza y asegura saber que él la va a proteger siempre; mientas que, internamente, contiene la rabia que siente por el hombre. Hansen siente cierta decepción cuando Adelaida sugiere que lo quiere como un hermano y confía en que él no sería capaz de ocultarle algo que le hiciera daño. Carlos está a punto de confesarle su amor a la mujer, pero desiste cuando ella le habla de que su único sueño es que su amor por Hilario convierta su matrimonio en algo distinto a lo que es actualmente.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E027
programme.desc: Hilario de forma astuta maneja la situación frente a Leopoldo y los policías que lo acompañan, de tal manera que Monteverde queda como único indiciado en el secuestro de Fernanda. Victoria asegura que va a demostrarle a Nicolás que está equivocado sobre Hilario, pero él le indica que no es así, pues a Guanipa lo encontraron en el lugar donde tenía secuestrada a Fernanda aunque él supo librarse de lo ocurrido; la pareja acuerda defender su amor y tratar de superar lo que los separa. Hilario se presenta en casa de Carmencita a conversar con Victoria pero, en vista de que no está, decide aprovechar la oportunidad para explicarle a Adelaida que él la ama a pesar de tener otras mujeres.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E04
programme.desc: Después de escoger la torta que le hará Matilde, Beatrice revela a Adriana que Carlos Raúl tiene novia desde hace muchos años.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E23
programme.desc: Gertrudis recuerda a Claudio la conveniencia de mantener su relación oculta para no levantar sospechas, pero viviendo la libertad de su amor. Guillermo una vez más lanza una sentencia de muerte sobre Alberto, si a Lorena se le ocurre dejarlo por él - Alberto se presenta en casa de Lorena, con la excusa de saber cómo sigue Ignacio; ella se aterra pues recuerda la amenaza de Guillermo, le dice que no es una buena idea que él esté allí, pero Alberto enamorado le contesta que no puede, no quiere, ni piensa irse de su vida.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E24
programme.desc: Pablo le pide una vez más a Malena que regrese a la casa o de lo contrario hará público su "romance" con Isabel. programme.desc: Adelaida se molesta con Hilario porque el hombre se niega a darle explicaciones sobre su problema con Nicolás; la señora se marcha furiosa; mientras que, los hombres se quedan discutiendo porque Del Casal advierte a Guanipa que no piensa permitir que intervenga en su relación con Victoria. programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E029 - Episodio 29
programme.desc: Nicolás asegura a Victoria que quien estaba tras los matorrales era el mismo perro que se llevó su ropa la vez anterior; la muchacha insta a su amado a que se vista y se marche de Cantarrana antes de que alguien lo descubra, pues eso podría traerles problemas con Hilario; ninguno de los dos se percata de que Moncho los ha visto. programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E031
programme.desc: Victoria trata de hacerle entender a Hilario que ella y Nicolás se aman sin importarle los odios del pasado entre su familia. Isaura y Carmencita están decididas a buscar la manera de convencer a Adelaida de que el verdadero Hilario no es el que le escribe las cartas. Yosmir le hace creer a Isaura que está saliendo con la hija del dueño de la carnicería para conseguir que la señora le preste dinero. Victoria asegura a Nicolás que no volverá a creer en sus mentiras, pues ya leyó todos sus correos y descubrió su plan; él aunque no entiende de qué le habla, le ruega que no se deje engañar por Hilario y sigan adelante con su idea de casarse; ella decide quemar Los Samanes e insta a Nicolás a marcharse de Cantarrana en la avioneta que le tiene preparada, pues ella está decidida a matar el amor que siente por él para siempre. Adelaida admite ante Carmencita que debe reconocer que Hilario nunca va a dejar de hacerla sufrir, pero ella tampoco va a dejar de amarlo.

programme.desc: Finding a mate, building a nest, and raising kids are all part of the whole reproductive behavior thing. But it’s not as easy as it sounds. First, you’ve got to sift through lots of possible partners to find the one with the best genes to keep your family line going. Nesting involves finding some space and then guarding it fiercely, while raising the little ones takes loads of energy as you have to feed, teach, and keep them safe until they grow up. This episode dives into the ins and outs of how creatures go about their reproductive business.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E06 - Hot Hot Heat
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they turn up the thermostat and discover the role heat plays in science. This week’s experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E07 - Explosive Elements
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests discover the unstable world of elemental gasses. This week’s experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E08 - Colorful Conundrums
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they taste the scientific rainbow. This week’s experiments highlight how electricity can tint titanium, how you can create a color wheel by lighting things on fire, and why the world gets all its colors from white light.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E01 - Science On Fire
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they kindle our curiosity about the science behind fire. This week’s experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.desc: Data centers already devour massive amounts of energy. AI is making their power consumption skyrocket. Energy bills are already rising. Brownouts will be next. Do we have the juice to power a digital world? Researchers are looking for groundbreaking solutions.

programme.desc: How did the western United States become a hotspot for unwieldy and devastating forest fires? Learn how the history of forest management and loss of public trust, coupled with climate change, have led to the conditions driving mega-fire nearly year-round.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E09 - Buck Warrant and ORV Stickers
programme.desc: In Michigan, officers from District 7 handle cases involving people fishing without licenses and boats that aren't registered. Plus, a conservation officer in the Upper Peninsula looks into an off-road vehicle missing its required stickers.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E10 - Michigan Elk
programme.desc: In District 3, Michigan conservation officers are looking into a case where a bull elk was shot using a tag meant for a cow. They're also checking out another elk that was taken on private land without the owner's okay.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E03 - Bear In Focus
programme.desc: A group of conservationists are observing a family of black bears in the wooded hills of Oklahoma, and Ivan gets to meet them.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E04 - Aggressive Measures
programme.desc: Ivan goes to Mozambique to join an anti-poaching team that focuses on catching poachers and protecting at-risk animals.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S07:E08 - Croxteth Hall Part 2
programme.desc: The upper floors that once buzzed with servants' daily routines now host echoes of a paranormal past. Stuart walks the corridors.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S07:E09 - Capesthorne Hall
programme.desc: Yvette and Mary explore upper rooms; Karl and Stuart investigate east wing of a mansion filled with ghostly tales. What will they uncover?

programme.desc: Diana, Princess of Wales, was incredibly enchanting and unforgettable, leaving a lasting impact like no other woman of her era. Known as a fairy-tale princess, a loving wife, a dedicated mother, and a style icon, this documentary digs deeper to uncover the true person behind the endless spotlight.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: When Andrew and Sarah Ferguson tied the knot, she soon became one of the most popular women to be called the Duchess of York since the title was created back in 1385.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E03 - William And Kate A New Royal Family

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E04 - Elizabeth At 80 Continuity And Change

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys

programme.desc: Michigan conservation officers are investigating cases where salmon were caught illegally, like in restricted streams or using banned gear. One officer took the time to show a family the right spots where they can fish legally.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E12 - Deer Seasons
programme.desc: Michigan Conservation Officers patrol the opening days of deer season for hunting with both archery equipment and firearms; a CO helps remove two deer from an elementary school after they crashed through a window in the dead of night.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E01 - Sinking Cities
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. In this episode, travel with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore across the region to understand what is causing cities to sink, how they are being monitored, and why building resilience into communities is critical to their long-term survival.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E01 - The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska. It’s here where a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat these fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E02 - Fish Like A Bear
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mom and her three cubs. They arrive at their destination and see many bears that they have already met as well as some new faces.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E03 - A Working Ecosystem
programme.desc: Everyone hates biting insects, but if you look closer you can see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem. During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E04 - The Wolf and the Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot where a large number of bears have gathered.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: Today‘s journey in search of more miracles of nature brings us to the Masurian Lake District which is an impressive water world in north-eastern Poland. We will then trade in the cool Baltic region for tropical Caribbean. Here we will prove that it would be wrong to link the Cuban province of Guantanamo only with the famous American naval base. To wrap things up, we will return to Europe’s Mediterranean region to visit people of the Lipari Islands who continue to survive in the shade of ever-smouldering volcanoes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Thailand is one of the few countries in south-east Asia that has never been a European colony. Perhaps the word "thai" which means "free" has something to do with it. It is possibly the reason why this country evokes a certain magic that sets it apart from the surrounding countries. From Thailand we travel to Sri Lanka.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
programme.desc: Miracles of Nature has travelled to the four corners of the Earth - we look back over the astonishing range of destinations visited – each offering remarkable and stunning sights combined with dramatic histories and awe inspiring beauty.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: From a regular student to a royal girlfriend, Kate Middleton has transformed into a real-life princess. In less than ten years, this everyday girl with a normal background captured her prince's heart and is now on track to become the future Queen of England.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life
programme.desc: The raft continues to cause problems as Chris and Casey spend valuable energy trying to stay afloat. With their days in the South Pacific dwindling, the brothers have reached their breaking point'until a new discovery leaves a lasting impact.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris and Casey have hiked across New Zealand for weeks. Fighting for their lives has taken a toll on their emotions and abilities. They team up to hunt feral pigs, but the cache items used for survival create new challenges and deep frustrations.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E13 - Lost Gill Net

Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.
